limitations: Four jobs implement two paired single-factor diagnostics; they are not four independent calibration points.
Static validation establishes serialization and identity only, not LS-DYNA parser/runtime acceptance.
A solver-completed diagnostic is not automatically an admissible P0 response.
The generic 4340 material and generic-steel EOS remain unvalidated for the real target system.
Unavailable response is never replaced with zero and targeted diagnostic data stay outside the reference response distribution.
The R06d failures establish a parser-contract defect only; they do not evaluate numerical or physical response.
R06e changes only shared database-output serialization and explicit documented defaults; the paired physics factors remain unchanged.
A local static PASS cannot promote Wave 0 without returned target-R15 parser and runtime evidence.
